facts.note: Rockstar Support (updated 3 Nov 2026): GTA VI "will release midnight local time on November 19, 2026, in all regions for both PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S". PlayStation Support says the same for PS5: "releases at midnight local time on November 19, 2026". So each time zone unlocks at its own midnight. The PlayStation Store and Xbox Store listings carry one release instant per store region (identical on both stores), which is when that region first opens, at midnight in its easternmost zone: the US store at 05:00 UTC (00:00 Eastern); Los Angeles follows at 08:00 UTC. Changed 18 Nov 2026 from one instant per store region, after checking both support pages.

Eurogamer.de: GTA 6 Cheats: Alle 61 Codes für Geld, Waffen, Fahrzeuge und wie ihr sie freischaltet (updated 23 Nov 2026)

facts.note: PC Gamer and GameSpot (18 Nov 2026, both tested in the game): cheats work only after the main story is finished, each one also needs its own challenge, they are entered on the phone with L1 + R1 and D-pad directions, and using one stops the game from saving. Rockstar has published nothing about cheats. Both articles opened by us in Chrome on 18 Nov 2026. Polygon (Giovanni Colantonio, 19 Nov 2026, tested on PS5; opened by us in Chrome 19 Nov) says the same about the story, the phone and saving, and adds that achievements can't be earned while a cheat is on. Kotaku (Imran Khan, 19 Nov 2026; read by us 20 Nov) gives the same method with LB/RB on Xbox and says the codes are the same on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. PC Gamer's list, updated 19 Nov 2026 and re-read by us on 21 Nov, now prints 19 codes, the same ones as GameSpot plus Drunk. Eurogamer.de (published 18 Nov, updated 23 Nov 2026 10:56 UTC; read by us 23 Nov 12:20 UTC) is the first to print all 61 codes with their unlocks; its codes match all 19 the English outlets print. It also says there is no god mode, flying or lose-wanted cheat, slow input works, and releasing L1 + R1 confirms the code with a chime. The codes and unlocks are in src/content/cheats.ts.

sources.name: GameSpot: GTA 6 Passes 17 Million Copies Sold And $1.6 Billion In Revenue On Eve Of Launch (18 Nov 2026)

facts.note: GameSpot (Eddie Makuch, 18 Nov 2026 12:37 UTC), citing Sensor Tower's sales tracker: 17.07 million units sold via pre-purchases before launch, about $1.65 billion gross revenue; 12.73 million on PS5 ($1.23 billion) and 4.35 million on Xbox Series X|S ($419 million), a 75/25 split. An unofficial third-party estimate, not a Take-Two or Rockstar figure. Opened by us on 19 Nov 2026 at 05:10 UTC.

sources.name: VGC: GTA 6 sold around 25 million copies and made $2.36 billion in its first day, estimates suggest (20 Nov 2026)

facts.note: VGC (Chris Scullion, 20 Nov 2026 09:42 UTC), citing Sensor Tower's estimate: 24.58 million copies sold by the end of the first day (19 Nov 2026), about 75% of them on PS5 (roughly 18.4 million) and around 6.15 million on Xbox Series X|S. An unofficial third-party estimate. Take-Two has since published its own figure for copies sold before release (preReleaseUnitsMillionsOfficial, 32.5 million) but no day-one unit count. Opened by us on 20 Nov 2026 at 10:15 UTC.

sources.name: VGC: GTA 6 sold around 25 million copies and made $2.36 billion in its first day, estimates suggest (20 Nov 2026)

facts.note: VGC (Chris Scullion, 20 Nov 2026 09:42 UTC), citing Sensor Tower's estimate: around $2.36 billion in total revenue on the first day (19 Nov 2026), from an estimated 24.58 million copies. GTA 5 made more than $815 million from about 11.21 million copies in its first day. An unofficial third-party estimate. Take-Two has since published its own day-one figure: $3.79 billion in retail sales (dayOneRetailSalesUsdBillions). Opened by us on 20 Nov 2026 at 10:15 UTC.

sources.name: Take-Two Interactive: Grand Theft Auto VI Shatters Entertainment Box Office Records with $3.79 Billion in Day One Retail Sales (20 Nov 2026)

facts.note: Take-Two's press release (Business Wire, 20 Nov 2026): GTA VI sold 32.5 million units pre-release, a record across all platforms. The release gives no cut-off date and does not say whether the units are sold-in or sold-through. Opened by us on 20 Nov 2026 at 20:15 UTC.

An unofficial third-party estimate, not a Take-Two or Rockstar figure. Opened by us on 23 Nov 2026 at 22:09 UTC.

sources.name: GameSpot: GTA 6 is approaching an absurd new sales milestone, report says (23 Nov 2026)

facts.note: GameSpot (Eddie Makuch, 23 Nov 2026 13:47 UTC), citing Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics: around 40.8 million people logged in to play GTA 6 on Sunday 22 Nov 2026, 76% of them on PS5; about 20% of players, roughly 9 million people, have played more than 20 hours. sources.name: Push Square: 61% of All US PS5 Owners Played GTA 6 on Launch Day, Averaging 8 Hours (21 Nov 2026)

facts.note: Push Square (Sammy Barker, 21 Nov 2026 02:00 UTC), quoting Circana analyst Mat Piscatella's Player Engagement Tracker: of US PlayStation 5 players active on 19 Nov 2026, 61% played GTA VI (56% of global Xbox players), and PS5 GTA VI players averaged 513 minutes (about 8.5 hours) that day, Xbox players 494. A third-party tracker, not a Rockstar or Sony figure. Opened by us on 21 Nov 2026 at 02:15 UTC.
